dedupe_keys.name: simulation models and fragility functions for tessellated structural architectural reinforced concrete walls

description: Simulation Models and Fragility Functions for Tessellated Structural-Architectural Reinforced Concrete Walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Pinar Okumus, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). This project introduced a new modular reinforced concrete shear wall system designed for replaceability and resilience after extreme loading as well as architectural appeal. The walls are called tessellated structural-architectural (TeSA) walls because they consist of interlocking tiles (modules) with repetitive shapes (tessellations) and are intended to satisfy both structural and architectural demands. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: RC Shear Walls, Tessellations, Modular Construction, Fragility Functions, Continuum Element Models, Fiber Element Models. Published 2023-01-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
